fusions.name: Common Thread
fusions.desc: You roll the target up for 12 damage, leaving it 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Muddled] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Tangling Thrash
fusions.desc: You thrash, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 30% chance to leave each [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Draped Bank
fusions.desc: Veils you and your allies for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Stitch by Stitch
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you are healed for 4% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
